faq: Do you change my theme or build a new one?
We work inside your current theme where we can. If the theme is too limited we tell you before starting, and offer a cleaner option. Nothing is published until you approve the preview.
Will you write the product descriptions too?
We write short benefit lines and layout labels for the template. Full descriptions for every product are a separate order, because they depend on how many products you have.
Can the new layout be applied to all my products?
Yes. A template applies to every product that uses it. Packages state how many templates we build, so you can give us your best seller type first.
Do you take the product photos?
No. We arrange the photos you already have and tell you which extra shots would help most, such as a size reference or a close up of the material.

desc:
Product page redesign for more sales rearranges the photos, price, variants and details of your product page so shoppers can decide quickly. Ecom Swift LLC redesigns the page in your own store and shows you a preview before anything goes live.

## Why the product page decides the sale

The product page is where a shopper makes the decision to buy. Everything before it, the ad, the search result and the collection, only brings the shopper here. If the page leaves a question unanswered, the shopper has no one to ask and usually leaves to look elsewhere.

Common gaps are easy to spot once you look for them: photos that do not show scale, a price that is hard to find, a size choice with no size guide, shipping information that hides in the footer and a buy button that sits below a long block of text.

## What makes a product page easy to buy from?

An easy product page answers the shopper's questions in the order they ask them. What is it, what does it look like, what does it cost, which option do I choose, when will it arrive and can I return it? Each answer sits close to the buy button, so the shopper does not scroll in circles.

Design supports that order. A clean gallery, a clear title, a visible price and a well labeled variant picker let a shopper act in a few seconds. Details that need more reading sit below, in short sections that can be scanned.

## How layout changes conversions

Layout affects behavior because shoppers skim. They look at the images, the price and the button first, and read the rest only if the first look is encouraging. A layout that puts these three items together and answers the likely doubts nearby reduces effort and uncertainty.

On phones the effect is stronger. A page that needs a lot of scrolling before the buy button appears loses patient shoppers. A sticky buy button, a compact gallery and short benefit lines help. Your product, price and audience also matter, so we focus on what the redesign improves and not on promises of sales.

## What a strong product page includes

- A gallery with sharp images, a clear first photo and zoom on tap or hover.
- A product title that states what the item is in plain words.
- Price, sale price and any savings that are easy to see.
- A variant picker that shows color, size and availability clearly.
- A size guide or measurement help where sizing causes doubt.
- Two or three benefit lines written in the shopper's language.
- A buy button that is large, clear and visible on mobile.
- Shipping and returns information placed close to the button.
- Review stars near the title where you have genuine reviews.
- Extra sections, such as a comparison table, a short FAQ or a video, below the main block.

## How we redesign your page

We begin by studying your best selling products and the questions customers ask most often. We then plan a layout for your product template, working in your own theme, on a private copy where that is possible. We arrange the sections, write clearer benefit lines and add missing information such as sizing or shipping.

We check the page on several phone sizes and on desktop, test that variants, prices and the buy button work, and share a preview link. You review it and ask for changes before it goes live. Because the work is done on the template, the new layout can apply to many products at once.

The Basic package redesigns one product page template with mobile checks. The Standard package covers up to two templates and adds a variant picker, size guide, shipping and returns block and review stars. The Premium package covers more templates and adds a sticky mobile buy button, a comparison table or FAQ, zoom and video slots and handover notes. Add-ons include extra templates, size guide design and a product video slot.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Lead with your clearest, sharpest product photo.
- Put price and buy button within the first view on phones.
- Answer shipping and returns questions on the page.
- Keep descriptions short and scannable.
- Show real reviews only.

**Avoid:**
- Hiding size or material details behind several tabs.
- Using low quality or inconsistent product images.
- Crowding the page with badges, banners and pop-ups.
- Copying manufacturer text word for word.
- Changing the page without checking it on a phone.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store whose product pages get views but few add to cart clicks, an owner who has changed themes and finds the product layout no longer fits their products, and a seller preparing a hero product page for a campaign.

## What we need from you

Send the product links you want improved, your best photos and any size, shipping or material details you have. Collaborator, staff or developer access is enough for us to edit the theme, and no password is ever needed. A reply with a short list of questions follows your order.
